## Devices of the original lab that are no longer used

| Original device | Why it was removed |
|---|---|
| Router2 | Sat between the hub and the Users switch, so inter-VLAN traffic could be routed around the firewall. FW-EDGE now routes every VLAN itself and is the single enforcement point. |
| Router3 | Sat between the hub and the second LAN for the same reason. The DMZ switch now connects directly to the firewall. |
